seo.title: Privacy Policy and Data Processing
seo.description: Learn about our privacy policy and personal data processing. At Jhamf Group SAS, we protect your information in accordance with the law.
seo.keywords: Privacy policy, Data processing Jhamf, Personal data protection Colombia

content.intro: At JHAMF GROUP SAS, we are committed to protecting the privacy and personal data of our customers, users, and partners. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your information.

section1.title: 1. Data Controller
section1.text: JHAMF GROUP SAS, a legally constituted company, is responsible for the processing of personal data.

section2.title: 2. Purpose of Processing
section2.text: Your personal data will be used for:
list: Provision of consulting and technology services.
Communication about news, events, and services.
Compliance with legal and contractual obligations.
Improvement of our services through analysis and statistics.

section3.title: 3. Rights of the Data Subjects
section3.text: As the data subject, you have the right to know, update, rectify, and delete your personal information, as well as to revoke the authorization granted for its processing.

content.note: Note: This is an informative summary. To learn all the legal details, please download the official PDF document using the button above.
